FES General Plasma Science: budget per year regardless of the number of participating institutions

match.appliesTo: OTA awards only (at least 50% to the maximum extent practicable); not required for grants under 2 C.F.R. part 200 and 910
match.quote: For OTA awards, to the maximum extent practicable, non-Federal parties carrying out a research, development, and demonstration project under an OTA award are to provide at least 50% cost sharing.

award.quote: We anticipate making awards with a project period of six months to five years, with a most common project period of three years.

sections.name: Pre-application
sections.conditional: Required for certain review panels; optional for all other submissions
sections.quote: The title page must be followed by a clear and concise description of the objectives and technical approach of the proposed research. The pre-application may not exceed three pages,

sections.name: Project Summary/Abstract
sections.quote: The description of the proposed research may not exceed one page (excluding Project Title and list of investigators)

sections.name: Title Page Supplement for Collaborative Applications
sections.quote: If a multi-institutional team is submitting collaborative applications, provide the following information on a separate page as a supplement to the title page.

sections.name: Buy America Infrastructure Statement
sections.quote: Within the first two (2) pages of the Project Narrative, include a short statement on whether the project will involve the construction, alteration, maintenance and/or repair of public infrastructure in the U.S.

sections.name: Background/Introduction
sections.quote: Background/Introduction: explanation of the importance and relevance of the proposed work as well as a review of the relevant literature

sections.name: Project Objectives
sections.quote: Project Objectives: a clear, concise statement of the specific objectives or aims of the proposed project

sections.name: Progress Report
sections.quote: Progress Report (for renewal applications only): a section that describes the results of the work accomplished during the current project period

sections.name: Proposed Research and Methods
sections.quote: Proposed Research and Methods: the hypotheses to be tested (if any) and details of the methods to be used, including the integration of experiments with theoretical and computational research efforts.

sections.name: Advancement of Basic Scientific Understanding (for-profit applicants)
sections.quote: All for-profit applicants must include a description as an appendix to the Project Narrative, not to exceed 200 words, of how their proposed work will advance scientific understanding of a basic and fundamental nature.

sections.name: Bibliography & References Cited
sections.quote: Provide a bibliography of any references cited in the Project Narrative. Each reference must include the names of all authors

sections.name: Facilities and Other Resources
sections.quote: This information is used to assess the capability of the organizational resources, including subrecipient resources, available to perform the effort proposed.

sections.name: Equipment
sections.quote: List major items of equipment already available for this project and, if appropriate, identify location and pertinent capabilities.

sections.name: Data Management and Sharing Plan
sections.conditional: Not required for conference, workshop, or scientific meeting support applications
sections.quote: Provide a Data Management and Sharing Plan (DMSP) as an appendix to the Project Narrative. DMSPs are not required for applications that only request support for a conference, workshop, or scientific meeting.

sections.name: Synergistic Activities
sections.conditional: Optional; one page per senior/key person
sections.quote: each senior/key person may provide a one-page list of no more than five distinct examples of synergistic activities

criteria.name: Scientific and/or Technical Merit of the Project
criteria.quote: What is the scientific innovation of the proposed research? What is the likelihood of achieving valuable results?

criteria.name: Appropriateness of the Proposed Method or Approach
criteria.quote: How logical and feasible are the research approaches? Does the proposed research employ innovative concepts or methods?

criteria.name: Competency of Applicant's Personnel and Adequacy of Proposed Resources
criteria.quote: How well qualified is the research team to carry out the proposed research? Are the research environment and facilities adequate for performing the research?

criteria.name: Reasonableness and Appropriateness of the Proposed Budget
criteria.quote: Are the proposed budget and staffing levels adequate to carry out the proposed research? Is the budget reasonable and appropriate for the scope?

criteria.name: Appropriateness of the Data Management and Sharing Plan
criteria.quote: To what extent does the Data Management and Sharing Plan (DMSP) enable data generated during the research project to be publicly shared and preserved

other: DOE Title Page, Project Narrative, and all required appendices go in one single machine-readable plain PDF attached to Field 8 (not scanned; no editable fields, signatures, passwords, portfolios or binders)
Do not attach appendices separately to Fields 9, 10, 11 or 12 of the Other Project Information form
Do not include URLs that provide supplementary information forming part of the application
Letters of collaboration or access go in Appendix 7, may contain only two sentences in the prescribed format; letters of recommendation are not allowed
Disclose use of any AI tools in the application unless used solely for editing an original draft
Applications submitted through Grants.gov only (not FedConnect or PAMS); pre-applications submitted only through PAMS, must be machine-readable
Pre-application: title page does not count toward the three-page limit; figures and references must fit within three pages
BER: research narratives longer than 15 pages may be declined without review

HENP (FY 2028 comparative review): project narratives no longer than nine pages per senior/key person; multi-institutional collaborative applications nine pages per senior/key person or 20 pages total, whichever is less
Nuclear Physics FY 2027 comparative review: narratives longer than 20 pages (plus five pages per major research thrust or task) may be declined; narrative reference list must not exceed three pages
FES FY 2028 FM&IC comparative review: narratives over 10 pages (requests of $1,000,000 or less) or over 20 pages (larger requests) may burden reviewers
FES FY 2028 FNS comparative review: narratives over 15 pages (requests under $1,500,000) or over 20 pages (larger requests) may burden reviewers
Subaward budget file names use up to 10 letters of the subrecipient's name and must not exceed 50 characters
format.quote: when printed using standard letter-size (8.5-inch x 11-inch) paper with 1-inch margins (top, bottom, left, and right). The body text font of all main text must not be smaller than 11 point.

eligibility.item: All types of applicants are eligible except 501(c)(4) nonprofits that engaged in lobbying activities after December 31, 1995
eligibility.quote: All types of applicants are eligible to apply, except nonprofit organizations described in section 501(c)(4) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 that engaged in lobbying activities after December 31, 1995.

eligibility.item: DOE/NNSA National Laboratories may not apply but may be proposed as subrecipients
eligibility.quote: DOE/National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA) National Laboratories are not eligible to submit applications under this NOFO but may be proposed as subrecipients

eligibility.item: Non-DOE/NNSA FFRDCs may apply as lead or team member, or be proposed as subrecipients
eligibility.quote: Non-DOE/NNSA Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs) are eligible to submit applications (either as a lead organization or as a team member in a multi- institutional team)

eligibility.item: Other Federal agencies may apply as lead or team member, or be proposed as subrecipients
eligibility.quote: Other Federal agencies are eligible to submit applications (either as a lead organization or as a team member in a multi-institutional team)

eligibility.item: Non-domestic applicants must demonstrate skills, resources, and abilities that do not exist among potential domestic applicants
eligibility.quote: For non-domestic applicants, successful applications include a detailed demonstration of how the applicant possesses the skills, resources, and abilities that do not exist among potential domestic applicants.

eligibility.item: Research must be basic research; work related to current commercial activity or customer needs may be declined without merit review
eligibility.quote: Applications that propose research related to current commercial activity or current customer needs may be declined without merit review.

eligibility.item: Entities debarred, suspended, or otherwise excluded from Federal programs are ineligible as recipient, subrecipient, or subcontractor
eligibility.quote: entities banned from doing business with the U.S. government, such as entities debarred, suspended, or otherwise excluded from or ineligible for participating in Federal programs

eligibility.item: Entities on the Treasury OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list are ineligible
eligibility.quote: Entities identified on the Department of the Treasury Office of Foreign Assets Control Treasury's Sanctions Program Specially Designated Nationals list

eligibility.item: Entities of Concern are prohibited from participating
eligibility.quote: Entities of Concern are prohibited from participating in projects under this NOFO.

eligibility.item: Individuals with the skills, knowledge, and resources to serve as PI work with their organizations to apply
eligibility.quote: Individuals with the skills, knowledge, and resources necessary to carry out the proposed research as a Principal Investigator (PI) are invited to work with their organizations to develop an application.

eligibility.item: Research must fall within the technical parameters of the NOFO and be based on established scientific principles
eligibility.quote: Applications that fall outside the technical parameters specified in Background and Context Project concepts or approaches not based on established scientific principles

eligibility.item: All work must be basic and fundamental research publishable in scholarly literature; no restricted data or unclassified controlled nuclear information
eligibility.quote: All work proposed under this NOFO must be for basic and fundamental research whose results may be published in scholarly literature.

eligibility.item: For panel reviews, an application must be associated with an encouraged pre-application to be considered by the panel
eligibility.quote: To be considered by the panel, an application must be associated with an encouraged pre- application

eligibility.item: Only the lead institution of a multi-institutional collaborative team may submit a pre-application
eligibility.quote: If a multi-institutional team is submitting collaborative applications, only the lead institution may submit a pre-application.

eligibility.item: Register with SAM.gov and obtain a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI)
eligibility.quote: Applicants must register with SAM.gov and obtain a Unique Entity Identifier (UEI).

eligibility.item: Provide an IRS-assigned EIN as the TIN for SAM.gov registration; do not use a social security number
eligibility.quote: Applicants must provide a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) to complete their registration in SAM.gov.

requiredDocuments.item: DOE Title Page (project title, applicant, PIs, contacts, NOFO number, program office, senior/key personnel, budget table), first page of the Project Narrative file in Field 8
requiredDocuments.quote: The application narrative must begin with a title page. The title page must include the following items:
Complete this form first to populate data in other forms. Complete all the required fields in accordance with the pop-up instructions on the form.

requiredDocuments.item: Research and Related Other Project Information form (Fields 1-6)
requiredDocuments.quote: Complete questions in Fields 1 through 6 of the SF-424 Research and Related Other Project Information form.

requiredDocuments.item: Identification of Merit Reviewer Conflicts list (Field 12)
requiredDocuments.quote: Provide a list of individuals who should not serve as merit reviewers of this application, following the instructions in Part 2 of this NOFO.

requiredDocuments.item: Research and Related Senior/Key Person Profile (Expanded) form with each person's biographical sketch and current and pending support
requiredDocuments.quote: Attach the person's biographical sketch, following the instructions in Part 2 of this NOFO for crafting a biographical sketch.

requiredDocuments.item: Research and Related Budget form, a separate budget for each year of support
requiredDocuments.quote: You must complete a separate budget for each year of support requested.

requiredDocuments.item: Budget Justification (Field L) for the entire project period, including the indirect cost rate agreement
requiredDocuments.quote: Provide a justification that explains all costs proposed in the budget.

requiredDocuments.item: R&R Subaward Budget Attachments form with a separate budget and budget justification for each subrecipient (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.quote: You must provide a separate R&R budget and budget justification for each subrecipient.
Indicate the primary site where the work will be performed.

requiredDocuments.item: SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities (if non-Federal funds were paid for lobbying)
requiredDocuments.quote: you must complete and submit Standard Form - LLL, Disclosure Form to Report Lobbying.

requiredDocuments.item: Transparency of Foreign Connections disclosure for the applicant and each proposed subrecipient, with signature, date, and certification (Appendix 6)
requiredDocuments.quote: Include a separate disclosure for the applicant and each proposed subrecipient.

requiredDocuments.item: Pre-application: list of senior/key personnel and list of individuals who should not serve as merit reviewers, as an Additional Attachment in PAMS
requiredDocuments.quote: the pre-application must include a list of senior/key personnel and a listing of individuals who should not serve as merit reviewers of a subsequent application.

requiredDocuments.item: Document from the facility manager confirming access to experimental user facilities maintained by other institutions (if applicable)
requiredDocuments.quote: provide a document from the facility manager confirming that researchers will have access to the facility.

requiredDocuments.item: Record of Discussion from DIII-D National Fusion Facility (if research includes DIII-D activities)
requiredDocuments.quote: then a Record of Discussion from the facility must be included in the submission.
